name: @razorgrowth/api
description: Vettri Vaanigam backend — Fastify API, agent gateway, Prisma/PostgreSQL.

scripts.//dev: Runs through node with the runtime-compat shim rather than the bare `tsx` binary: on Windows/Node 24 tsx can fail uv_os_get_passwd with ENOMEM while locating its temp dir, which made `pnpm dev` unusable and pushed people to start the API by hand — without --watch, so edits silently never reloaded.
scripts.//db:deploy: Container/CI variant: reads DATABASE_URL from the real process environment instead of a .env file, which does not exist in a production image.
scripts.//db:seed:env: Container variant of db:seed, same reasoning as db:deploy.
scripts.//db:identities: The shopper and platform-admin logins. Separate from db:seed because it provisions IDENTITIES against existing merchant data rather than creating a catalogue, and is safe to re-run.
scripts.//razorpay:proof: Exercises the real RazorpayPaymentGateway against live Test Mode and writes docs/evidence/razorpay-testmode-proof.json. Every automated test uses the mock gateway, so this is the only thing that proves the project can actually talk to Razorpay. Refuses to run against an rzp_live_ key.
